scope: One experimental confirmed actor-position publication from a Worker-owned clone into a frozen real mangrove-islands QA scene. QA animal ID 0 renamed in clone, 25 scene chunk keys, no physics manager in clone; only x/z/heading copied, no gameplay, routes, events, time, collision, smooth interpolation, animation synchronization, input, or production authority. The main scene remains a separate native world. The measured response contains the projection and observed events, but the scene only applies positions and heading; snapshot requested separately after measurement for validation. No event application, reliable delivery, collision validation or visual interpolation.
